# TimeInput

```ts
import { TimeInput } from '@cake-admin/cakeand';
```

Time Input collects a 12-hour time through separate hours and minutes segments plus an AM/PM selector. It composes Input Label and Helper String; use mode="range" when one shared helper describes a start/end interval. Use Number Input for a quantity rather than a clock time.

## Props

| Prop | Type | Default | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `mode` | `'single' \| 'range'` | `'single'` | Renders one time control or the Figma start/end range pair. |
| `label` | `string` | `'Select time'` | Label for the single control. |
| `startLabel` | `string` | `'Start time'` | Label for the range start control. |
| `endLabel` | `string` | `'End time'` | Label for the range end control. |
| `showLabelInfo` | `boolean` | `false` | Shows the InputLabel info icon(s). |
| `required` | `boolean` | `false` | Shows "(required)" and marks every native time segment required. |
| `helperText` | `React.ReactNode` | — | Helper content below the field(s). Defaults to the matching Figma guidance. |
| `showHelper` | `boolean` | `true` | Hides the shared HelperString. |
| `status` | `TimeStatus` | `'default'` | Validation state for all time controls. |
| `disabled` | `boolean` | `false` | Disables every segment and period choice. |
| `value` | `TimeValue` | — | Controlled value for mode="single". |
| `defaultValue` | `TimeValue` | — | Uncontrolled initial value for mode="single". |
| `onValueChange` | `(value: TimeValue) => void` | — | Fires with a complete segment object whenever a single value changes. |
| `rangeValue` | `TimeRangeValue` | — | Controlled start/end values for mode="range". |
| `defaultRangeValue` | `TimeRangeValue` | — | Uncontrolled initial start/end values for mode="range". |
| `onRangeValueChange` | `(value: TimeRangeValue) => void` | — | Fires with both segment objects whenever either range value changes. |


## Usage

```tsx
<TimeInput />
<TimeInput label="Appointment time" required showLabelInfo />
<TimeInput defaultValue={{ hours: '09', minutes: '30', period: 'AM' }} />
<TimeInput mode="range" startLabel="Start time" endLabel="End time" />
<TimeInput status="error" helperText="Choose a valid time" />
<TimeInput mode="range" disabled />
```

## Accessibility

- Each label is a real <label htmlFor> that focuses its hours segment; use the component in a labelled context rather than relying on placeholders.
- Hours/minutes expose clear segment names and numeric mobile input modes. Normalization happens on blur, so an incomplete value is not overwritten mid-entry.
- Radix ToggleGroup makes AM/PM a mutually exclusive keyboard-operable choice.
- Validation sets aria-invalid through the group’s validation styling and Helper String supplies explanatory text; disabled fields disable all inputs and period choices.

## Do / Don't

| Do | Don't |
| --- | --- |
| Use a 12-hour value with its AM/PM period. | Store 24-hour notation in the displayed segments. |
| Use range mode for one start/end interval. | Place two separate Time Inputs when their validation is shared. |
| Add helper guidance for timezone or duration context. | Assume a time alone communicates its timezone. |
| Validate chronological ranges in the parent form. | Treat the component’s segment bounds as range-order validation. |
